title: Answer: time is beats of one reversible rule, with the arrow from the coarse view

statements.text: Time is beats: whole steps with nothing between them, at each of which every dock applies the one rule at once. The rule is reversible, so a run goes backward exactly, and it has the same cone both ways. The arrow of time is the low-entropy start plus the coarse view: coarse entropy rises forward and under the exact inverse alike, while fine-grained entropy stays exactly constant (E-FND-0146, E-FND-0147).
statements.scope: the beat is a construction of the model. The arrow is a simulation result on the working rule over 17 starts
